payload.body: You tend to say yes to the larger plan before checking the cost, distance, promise, or practical limit. The risk feels especially attractive when caution sounds like someone else deciding what you are allowed to want. This often comes from learning that desire had to be defended by making it bigger and more certain than it really was. Check one concrete limit before treating hesitation as control.
